speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Roseola Infantum (Exanthem Subitum).

The combination of a recent viral prodrome (fever, rhinorrhea, headache) followed by the resolution of fever and the appearance of a pruritic, lacy reticular rash on the trunk and extremities is the classic presentation of Roseola. The normal inflammatory markers and specific rash morphology further support this viral etiology over a drug reaction or bacterial infection.
